$comment: PR 85 — the app's device gate (tools/device-gate.mjs), Blueprint Appendix C1/C2 and D1.4. Sizes: phones in devices.json, tablets in device-matrix.js (TABLETS), desktop in devices-desktop.json. URLs: lighthouserc.json (ci.collect.url). The rules below are the locked mobile-hardening minimums; 0 fails is the pass mark.

firstScreen.$comment: PR 53 (Blueprint D2, follow-up 60) — the first-screen budget. On every product page (pathPattern) on a phone, the size row and the measurement line (`blocks`) end above the top of the buy bar (`bar`) on the first screen, as it opens and again after the first size that can be chosen (`tap`) is tapped: FIRST-SCREEN. On a desktop the Add to Bag and Order Now buttons (`buy`) end above the fold: BUY-BELOW-FOLD. `slackPx` is rounding. On a phone the check waits for the budget's mark (`ready`, at most `readyMs`); a page where it never appears fails. Product pages come from signedIn.urls and the `discover` entries that open a category and take its first products, so every garment kind is measured.

filled.$comment: PR 107 — the bag with something in it, opened as a customer after the test server's sample-bag fill (POST /api/bag/try; only with EXTAS_SHOP_TEST_PAGES=1, sample data only). `expect` fails the page as CONTROL-MISSING when the bag rendered empty.
PR 71 — the wishlist with sample hearts (POST /api/wishlist/try, test servers only): its items, Add to bag for the saved size, Remove.

PR 131 — My account signed in as the sample customer (POST /api/account/try: test servers with the mock SMS sender only; the unallocated +88010 number and one sample order of the sample catalogue, never the owner's data): the header with its figures, the order card with the parcel's journey, the way home.
PR 131 — the other sections of My account, signed in the same way: For you, Rewards, Wallet, Profile (its forms) and the Wishlist inside the frame.
PR 134 — the sample account's own order page (TRY-131, made by the same fill): its lines, the money and how it is paid; PR 135 its tracking steps.

PR 65 — the sample account's delivered order (TRY-65, made by the same fill): "Rate & review" on its line, which opens the review form in place (the stars, the fit chips, his height and weight, the photo and his words).

PR 136 — the sample order's invoice (TRY-131, same fill): the sheet drawn from the stored order, Download and Print / Save as PDF pinned under it; the order page's "Get invoice" row and the invoice icon in My orders lead here.

The "Sending a gift" card's boxes (16 px text), its date box, the hide-prices tick and "Not a gift?" keep their 44 px taps; the bag's "Send as a gift" link under Checkout too.

opened.$comment: Follow-up 75 (PR 74) — the phone menu open with a category's sub-categories opened in place (the sample seed's "Knit polos" under Polos): its rows, "View all" first and the counts must keep their 44 px taps and fit the sheet. Phones and tablets narrower than 1024 px only (from 1024 px the desktop header has no phone menu). With the sheet open only its own controls are measured (what lies behind an aria-modal dialog cannot be tapped).

signedIn.$comment: Follow-up 5 of PR 85 — the signed-in run (--email/--password-file) on a database seeded with the sample catalogue (packages/seed sample, rules sample, combos sample: sample data only, never the owner's). Every lighthouserc path plus `urls` is opened with the session, except `signedOutPaths`. `discover` opens a page and adds the first `take` links its selector finds (required: none found fails the run). `expect` (per path, or per discover entry) lists the controls that only show with data; a page without them fails as CONTROL-MISSING, so the gate never passes on an empty page. PR 45-48: a category page with the sample polos (its grid, sizes and sort), opened signed out like a customer. PR 49-64: the product page with the sample products (a polo with five colours, trousers, a one-size pack; English and Bengali), opened signed out like a customer; `expect` needs the title, the colours or sizes and the Add button. PR 50/51/58: the T2 (Editorial) and T3 (Fit-first) sample polos in both languages: the stacked photos with the Find my size card, and the T3 card with its sizes, finder and measurements. PR 6: the Server page with its worker verdict. PR 72/73: the search results for polo (cards, the size filter, the sort) and for exchange (the help answer), signed out like a customer. PR 91–103: the combo pages on the sample combos (a polo + chino set in both languages, a three-tee pack with its popular pairs and "Same size as item 1") and the sets landing page, signed out like a customer; the chino page shows its set offer (PR 102). PR 98, 100: the set builder signed out like a customer — its "taking a break" page while the owner`s switch is off (the ready-made sets below it), and the test server`s preview (`?try=1`) of the sample draft Any polos rule with its tier cards, empty slots, style cards with Add, the summary and the phone bar, in both languages. PR 12 (CN-022): the new admin shell — the Dashboard with its two money tiles and Needs you now (today and 30 days), Help & manual with a guide button per section, a section placeholder (Customers) and the shell's not-found state (the same screen as its 404 page, which answers HTTP 404 and is the smoke test's check), at 390 / 768 / 1366 / 1920 like every page; the delivery page moved to /admin/delivery/zones (lighthouserc). Follow-up 200 (S05): the order list (all and to confirm), the To confirm call queue with its call card, and (discover) the first order page the list links to, with its customer card and Confirm button (the sample order is new).
